ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name Yatrika (Yatrika Travel Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.yatrika.example
Location Jaipur, Rajasthan
Incorporated March 2026
One-line description AI-planned family trips with local guides, taxis and stays.
Sector (as selected) Consumer tech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 4
Founders
Founder 1 Manish Joshi. 10 years running his family's travel agency in Jaipur, which
has served over 3,000 families. linkedin.com/in/manish-joshi-example
Founder 2 Kavya Nair. 3 years as a web developer. linkedin.com/in/kavya-nair-
example
Time commitment Both full-time since March 2026.
Prior startup experience Manish has run a family business. Kavya has none.
Equity split Founders 100%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A web app where families answer 6 questions and receive an AI-drafted
itinerary. The itinerary uses a language model and 40 hand-built route
templates. Bookings are confirmed manually on WhatsApp.
Customers 410 bookings since launch, covering about 1,300 travellers.
Revenue Total booking value INR 38.6 L. We earn a 12% commission, so revenue
is INR 4.6 L.
Repeat 14% of families have booked a second trip.
Customer acquisition Referrals from Manish's earlier agency customers and Instagram. Paid
acquisition is about INR 640 per booking.
Key risks Quality of local partners, seasonality and manual operations that do not
yet scale.

Fundraising
Amount raising INR 1.2 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 8 Cr post-money
Existing investors None.
Use of funds Marketing, technology, hiring, expansion.
Other investors in
conversation
None.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We are passionate about travel and would love to tell you more on a call.
